content:
While working on this:
#Is there code for X? > How to prove an instance of CompleteAtomicBooleanAlgebra
I found that I need a mathlib PR that was merged into mathlib only two days ago:
https://github.com/leanprover-community/mathlib4/pull/37605
which is not yet in the mathlib version used by cslib's main branch. What is the best way to update the mathlib in my local copy of cslib so that I can use that PR?
Put that branch of mathlib in rev
And set scope to the username of the user whose fork the PR comes from. Alternatively just change the name field of the mathlib dependency of “name = <username>/mathlib4” in lakefile.toml
I believe you can also specify the source of a GitHub repository with a field called git
Or more simply, just run lake update to pick up the lastest Mathlib master.
Thanks for the suggetions! Since that PR has been merged into mathlib, just changing the mathlib4's commit id in lake-manifest.json suffices.
I'd suggest that you do so via lake update for the sake of consistency with Mathlib's dependencies.
